summary: FB Financial Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $ fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes offering due 2036, with the coupon, aggregate principal, and spread left blank pending pricing. The notes pay a fixed rate to 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus a spread, with issuer call options from 2031 or on tax/Tier 2 capital/1940 Act events at par. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, structurally subordinated to FirstBank deposits, and subject to Federal Reserve approval for early redemption; not listed, no conversion feature.
